name: viral-video-decoder
description: 视频爆款拆解师：结合 Hypit 把视频还原成 SVML 脚本图（结构层），再用 WorkBuddy 用证据+套路框架提炼可复用创作模板（分析层），手把手带用户一步步拆解任意爆款视频。

displayDescription.en: Combine Hypit (structural SVML breakdown) with WorkBuddy (evidence + pattern analysis) to dissect any viral video step by step into a reusable creation template.
displayDescription.zh: 结合 Hypit 与 WorkBuddy，手把手带你拆解视频爆款，沉淀可复用套路模板。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 带我一步步拆解一条爆款视频：先用 Hypit 出结构化脚本，再用 WorkBuddy 提炼可复用套路
defaultInitPrompt.en: Walk me through dissecting a viral video: Hypit for structure, WorkBuddy for the reusable pattern

quickPrompts.en: Walk me through dissecting a viral video: Hypit for structure, WorkBuddy for the reusable pattern
quickPrompts.zh: 带我一步步拆解一条爆款视频：先用 Hypit 出结构化脚本，再用 WorkBuddy 提炼可复用套路

quickPrompts.en: I have a video file/link — dissect it using the observed/metric/inferred/unknown evidence tiers
quickPrompts.zh: 我有个视频文件/链接，帮我按证据四分级（observed/metric/inferred/unknown）做拆解

quickPrompts.en: After breaking this down, give me a reusable viral-pattern template I can follow
quickPrompts.zh: 把这条爆款拆完，给我一份可复用的爆款套路模板，方便我照着做
